title: Choose Appropriate Measures
focus: Choose measures of center and variability

items.stem: Which measure of center is most appropriate to use when data has extreme values or outliers?
A set of test scores is: 70, 72, 74, 75, 95. Which measure of center best represents the typical score, and why?
choices: Mean, because it includes all scores evenly
Median, because it is not affected by the high score of 95
Range, because it shows the spread between scores

items.stem: Select all statements that correctly explain when the median is a better measure of center than the mean. Show or explain your work.
choices: When the data set includes outliers or extreme values
When all data values are very close to each other
When the data is skewed to one side
When looking for the most frequently occurring value

items.stem: A researcher collected the following data on the number of books read by students in a month: 2, 3, 3, 4, 10. Decide whether the mean or the median is a better measure of center for this data set. Show or explain your work.
